edges: The UK developed and launched six satellites from 1962 to 1979 in collaboration with NASA.
The UK did not play a role in the 'Space Race' between the world's two military superpowers.

edges: Most workers in the UK over the age of 16 are legally entitled to a minimum rate of pay called the national minimum wage.
